title: Atlas Finding
description: One claim, the citations it rests on, and how far those have been checked. A verdict of "verified" or "contradicted" requires a typed claim — one stated as literal presence or absence over a cited source's observed lines, where the claim is the predicate — settled by atlas_core.claim_check. Citation checking alone never produces either: it establishes that a pointer is sound, which says nothing about whether the source supports the claim. A free-text claim therefore stays "insufficient_evidence" however sound its citations are.

severity.description: The severity that survived checking. Equal to `declared_severity` on a `verified` verdict, `unknown` otherwise. See `declared_severity`.

severity_rationale.description: Why this severity. A severity without a reason reads as assessed when it is not.

evidence.description: What the finding claims about each source it cites, checked against the run's observations rather than copied from them.

source_id.description: Must name an observation from this run.

quoted.description: Must be contiguous text at the claimed line range.

verification_method.description: How far the finding was checked. "deterministic_evidence_check" means the citation was checked and the claim was not. "semantic" means a typed claim was settled against the lines the run observed. "none" means no checker has looked at it: a finding is constructed this way, and a producer cannot set this field.

verdict.description: "insufficient_evidence" is the honest default, and what an unusable citation, an intact-but-unchecked claim and any free-text claim all earn: a broken pointer says the citation is unusable, never that the claim is false. "verified" and "contradicted" are reachable only for a typed claim, and only from atlas_core.claim_check — deterministic citation checking on its own cannot produce either. "verified" means the claim, stated as literal presence or absence over observed lines, held against those lines; it is not a judgement about a broader conclusion the finding might imply.

reproducible_command.description: A command that re-checks the claim, or "unknown". Never blank.

declared_severity.description: The severity the producer stated, kept whatever happens to `severity`. A producer declares an impact before anything is checked, so that number is only an assessment of something real once the claim it describes has been established: `severity` survives the check on a `verified` verdict and is `unknown` otherwise, including on `contradicted` — a refutation weighs an impact for something that is not the case. What the producer thought is not discarded; presenting it as established is what must not happen.
